basics.name: Xi Wang
basics.label: Lecturer in Natural Language Processing
basics.summary: I am a Lecturer (≈ Assistant Professor) in Natural Language Processing at the University of Sheffield. My research advances conversational AI, information retrieval, personalisation, and AI for mental health — with a focus on systems that actively interact with humans, knowledge, and agents to support everyday life.

location.address: COM135 Regent Court, School of Computer Science

work.name: University of Sheffield
work.summary: NLP Group, School of Computer Science. Research on conversational AI, retrieval-augmented generation, personalisation, user simulation, and AI for mental health. Teaching and PhD supervision.

work.name: University College London (UCL)
work.summary: Web Intelligence Group, Department of Computer Science. Worked with Prof. Emine Yilmaz on task-oriented dialogue systems and information retrieval, supported by a Google Research Workshop Grant.

courses: Supervisors: Prof. Iadh Ounis and Prof. Craig Macdonald

awards.title: Google Research Workshop Grant — Action, Task and User Journey
awards.summary: Co-recipient with Prof. Emine Yilmaz (UCL). $20,000 grant supporting research on task-oriented dialogue systems. Outcomes published at AAAI 2023 and EMNLP 2023.

awards.title: Gold Medal — Provincial ACM-ICPC International Collegiate Programming Contest
awards.summary: Awarded to the top-ranked team in the provincial ACM-ICPC programming contest.
